description: This Java class 'MenuFactory' provides methods to load and retrieve menu configurations from XML files, supporting web application context and location-based resource resolution. It manages caching of menu data and constructs 'ModelMenu' objects from XML elements.

classes.name: MenuFactory
classes.description: A factory class for loading and retrieving menu configurations from XML resources, supporting caching and context-based resolution.

methods.name: getMenuFromWebappContext
methods.description: Retrieves a ModelMenu object based on web application context, resource name, and menu name, using cache and XML parsing.

methods.name: readMenuDocument
methods.description: Parses an XML Document to construct a map of menu names to ModelMenu objects.

methods.name: getMenuFromLocation
methods.description: Retrieves a ModelMenu object based on resource location, menu name, and visual theme, using cache and XML parsing.
